Johan Burisch is a consultant physician (*afdelingslæge*) who holds both a Doctor of Medical Science (*dr.med.*) and a PhD [^src1]. He serves as a member of the steering committee for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD), representing the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*) [^src1]. 

His position on the steering committee places him at the strategic core of Denmark's national effort to systematize and improve the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. The DANIBD steering committee functions as the primary strategic management unit for the registry, overseeing cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines [^src1]. In this role, the committee utilizes detailed quality data—such as the metrics collected between October 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023—to conduct clinical benchmarking, evaluate patient access to treatment, and identify challenges in implementing specific quality indicators like patient education and the administration of biologics or small molecules [^src1]. Burisch's dual doctoral degrees underscore a deeply research-based approach to his clinical practice and his strategic oversight of IBD treatment protocols [^src1].
